cards.label: What you can do with Hoody
card.computers.body: A real Linux machine in the cloud that is yours. Open its terminal or its desktop in a browser tab and install anything.
card.programs.body: Start a web app on port 3000 and it gets its own web address. Open it in a browser tab or share the link. Nothing else to set up.
card.files.body: Browse, upload, edit and download the files on your computers, right here in the Hub.
card.agent: An AI agent on each computer
card.agent.body: Ask it to build, fix or look something up. It works on that computer, with its files and its programs.
card.bots.body: A Bot is an AI agent with standing instructions. Chat with it by link, {{telegram}}, {{slack}}, {{discord}} or the API. It asks before risky steps.
card.scripts.body: A script is a short program with its own web link: it runs when the link is called. A schedule runs a command on a timer, such as every night.
card.realms.body: A realm is a separate space, for a client or a team, with its own computers and keys. Projects group computers inside it.
card.keys.body: API keys let your own apps or terminal tools connect without your password. Limit what each key can touch and set an end date.
